title: French Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish inspired by North African cuisine, made with marinated chicken cooked in a rich and spicy French tagine.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together the tagine spice blend, cumin, coriander, paprika, cinnamon, ginger, and garlic.
3. Add the chicken to the spice mixture and toss to coat.
4. Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
5. Add the chicken to the pot and sear until browned, about 5 minutes.
6. Add the lemon juice to the pot and stir to deglaze.
7. Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and cook for 30 minutes.
8. Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the tagine spice blend.
9. Continue cooking for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
10. Serve the chicken hot, garnished with fresh parsley and lemon wedges.
